title: BROILED POTATOES
instructions: --Peel a half dozen medium-sized cooked potatoes, halve them and lay upon a dish, seasoning with

a pinch of salt, and pour over them two tablespoons of butter and roll them thoroughly in it. Then arrange them on a double broiler, and broil over a moderate fire for three minutes on each side. Serve in a folded napkin on a hot dish.
